label: First Way mover is necessary, from firstness and a distinct esse-cause (inference)
rule: Reductio on contingency, then excluded middle at each accessible world
meaning: Route A of the lead. The first mover f exists at w (B0). Were it contingent, B2 would give another being causing its esse, simply prior to it by B3, hence identical with it by firstness, against distinctness. So f is present at every accessible world (excluded middle). Pure act is carried for the same witness and does no work toward necessity here: the necessity comes from firstness and existential causation (cross-family convergence on one witness, not 'pure act alone entails necessity'). Omission models in the controls (models 1-6).
